program_goals.target_population: People with criminal records who may be interested in clearing, sealing, or otherwise addressing eligible records, especially individuals who face barriers to employment, housing, education, licensing, or other opportunities because of their record. The program is intended to reach people who need a simple, affordable way to understand their options and next steps, including those who may need referral to legal aid or an attorney when self-help is not appropriate.

sections.heading: Content this organization provides and approves

blocks.text: The content below is set by LegalEase. The partner cannot edit or approve it, and it appears on the page exactly as written here.

items.value: LegalEase provides self-help record-clearing tools and prepared documents. LegalEase is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice, and does not represent participants. Using this program does not create an attorney-client relationship.

items.term: What this program does and does not do
items.value: This program helps a participant prepare and file their own record-clearing paperwork. It stops short of legal representation. A contested matter, a prosecutor objection, or a scheduled contested hearing leaves the self-help path and follows the approved referral route.
Eligibility is decided by the court and by state law, not by this program. Nothing here guarantees that a record will be cleared or that any particular outcome will follow.
Participant information is handled under the LegalEase privacy practices. LegalEase does not sell participant information.
Sponsored participants pay nothing to LegalEase for the sponsored scope of this program. Court filing fees and other government charges are set by the court, not by LegalEase.
Participant routing between screening, document preparation, and the partner's own support is controlled by LegalEase so that a participant is never left without a next step.
The LegalEase terms of service, privacy policy, and accessibility statement apply to this page and are linked from it.

legalBlocks.body: LegalEase provides self-help record-clearing tools and prepared documents. LegalEase is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice, and does not represent participants. Using this program does not create an attorney-client relationship.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: LegalEase ofrece herramientas de autoayuda para la eliminación de antecedentes y documentos preparados. LegalEase no es un bufete de abogados, no ofrece asesoría legal ni representa a los participantes. Usar este programa no crea una relación entre abogado y cliente.
legalBlocks.heading: Legal disclaimer

legalBlocks.body: This program helps a participant prepare and file their own record-clearing paperwork. It stops short of legal representation. A contested matter, a prosecutor objection, or a scheduled contested hearing leaves the self-help path and follows the approved referral route.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: Este programa ayuda al participante a preparar y presentar sus propios documentos para la eliminación de antecedentes. No incluye representación legal. Un asunto controvertido, una objeción de la fiscalía o una audiencia controvertida programada sale de la ruta de autoayuda y sigue la ruta de remisión aprobada.
legalBlocks.heading: What this program does and does not do
legalBlocks.headingEs: Qué hace este programa y cuáles son sus límites

legalBlocks.body: Eligibility is decided by the court and by state law, not by this program. Nothing here guarantees that a record will be cleared or that any particular outcome will follow.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: La elegibilidad depende del tribunal y de la ley estatal, no de este programa. Nada aquí garantiza que se elimine un antecedente ni que se obtenga un resultado específico.
legalBlocks.heading: Eligibility and outcomes

legalBlocks.body: Participant information is handled under the LegalEase privacy practices. LegalEase does not sell participant information.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: La información de los participantes se maneja conforme a las prácticas de privacidad de LegalEase. LegalEase no vende la información de los participantes.
legalBlocks.heading: Privacy and security

legalBlocks.body: Sponsored participants pay nothing to LegalEase for the sponsored scope of this program. Court filing fees and other government charges are set by the court, not by LegalEase.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: Los participantes patrocinados no pagan a LegalEase por los servicios cubiertos por el patrocinio de este programa. Las tasas de presentación y otros cargos gubernamentales los fija el tribunal, no LegalEase.
legalBlocks.heading: Cost to the participant

legalBlocks.body: Participant routing between screening, document preparation, and the partner's own support is controlled by LegalEase so that a participant is never left without a next step.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: LegalEase controla las rutas entre la evaluación, la preparación de documentos y la asistencia de la organización para que el participante siempre tenga un siguiente paso.
legalBlocks.heading: Where participants are sent
legalBlocks.headingEs: A dónde se dirige a los participantes

legalBlocks.body: The LegalEase terms of service, privacy policy, and accessibility statement apply to this page and are linked from it.
legalBlocks.bodyEs: Las condiciones del servicio, la política de privacidad y la declaración de accesibilidad de LegalEase se aplican a esta página y están enlazadas desde ella.
